## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A Hoverfly-simulated login redirect makes the Substack descriptor report...

The system SHALL ensure that a Hoverfly-simulated login redirect makes the Substack descriptor report ready=false with code session_expired and the run produces zero rows rather than a partial result.

#### Scenario: A Hoverfly-simulated login redirect makes the Substack descriptor report...

WHEN `detect-substack-session-expiry-and-fail-readiness-closed` is implemented
THEN A Hoverfly-simulated login redirect makes the Substack descriptor report ready=false with code session_expired and the run produces zero rows rather than a partial result.

### Requirement: Patching a fresh cookie into the OpenBao cache flips the descriptor to...

The system SHALL ensure that patching a fresh cookie into the OpenBao cache flips the descriptor to ready=true in the same process without restart.

#### Scenario: Patching a fresh cookie into the OpenBao cache flips the descriptor to...

WHEN `detect-substack-session-expiry-and-fail-readiness-closed` is implemented
THEN Patching a fresh cookie into the OpenBao cache flips the descriptor to ready=true in the same process without restart.

### Requirement: The typed readiness failure is reusable by other adapters and carries no...

The system SHALL ensure that the typed readiness failure is reusable by other adapters and carries no cookie value in its message or payload.

#### Scenario: The typed readiness failure is reusable by other adapters and carries no...

WHEN `detect-substack-session-expiry-and-fail-readiness-closed` is implemented
THEN The typed readiness failure is reusable by other adapters and carries no cookie value in its message or payload.
